elements.text: Every control on these pages is one of the game widgets, lifted from the screen that owns it and built on a screen of RIX’s own.
Being worked on is listed first; the widgets that already work are under Working widgets.

items.label: Card grid
items.description: widget_TrunkZone - the deck editor card grid (wheel scrolling, the Filter panel), with the card details beside it.

items.label: Card box
items.description: widget_CardDisplay - the Random Pack Store's box of pulled cards, filled from a list of ids.

items.label: Working widgets
items.description: Menus, volume bar, digits, card details, Free Duel pickers, deck picker, message boxes.
